plugins.name: adversarial-review
plugins.description: Narrow-charter code review and a pre-send counter-check. One reviewer per invariant, each charged to refute it.

plugins.name: pr-craft
plugins.description: Make a pull request cheap to review and cheap to land: a reviewable split for a large mechanical diff, and CI diagnosis that returns instead of polling.

plugins.name: what-could-go-wrong
plugins.description: Answer an ordering, lifetime or concurrency worry with a concrete failing interleaving, or an honest no-finding. TLA+ behind the scenes, plain language in front.
